name: Gordaliza del Pino (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a white cross set towards the hoist and a green horizontal stripe edged yellow through the fly quarters, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Gordaliza del Pino (a pine, towers, grapes and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Gordaliza del Pino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
